catch_lines.line: A perch! Shiny as a new nickel, hon.
An old boot. Chompy's lunch is served.
Blue crab! He's waving like he owns the plaza.
Bluegill by the pavilions. Tourists clap.
Catfish under the plaza lights. Whiskers!
A traffic cone. Who parks in the harbor?
An eel! Slippery as a tax refund.
Night crab, snapping at the moonlight.
Rockfish off the old warship. Salute!
A rusty bucket. Bail out, sailor.
White perch, pale as a sail.
A crab climbed the line like a rigging rope.
Black drum! It hums like a deck gun.
A bald tire. Somebody's car is sad.
Bluefish by the bow. All teeth, no manners.
Crab by lantern light. Ahoy, little guy.
Perch near the glass tanks. Jealous fish.
A shopping cart! Chompy, dinner's big.
Blue crab on the aquarium pier. Ticket?
Rockfish with stripes like a deck chair.
Catfish thinks it escaped a tank. Nope.
A boot with the laces still tied. Spooky.
An eel wrapped the cane like a scarf.
SUNKEN KEY! Rusty, heavy, and very secret.
Bluegill by the brick stacks. Charged up!
A traffic cone under the old power pier.
Crab with attitude. He wants a rematch.
White perch, sparkling like a light bulb.
Black drum, booming under the neon glow.
A bucket of harbor soup. Chompy approves.
Bluefish snapping at the club bass line.
Night crab doing a sideways two-step.
Perch by the cobblestones. Classic catch.
A tire from the water taxi lane. Rude.
Blue crab, Fells Point's finest pincher.
SUNKEN KEY! It glints like an old secret.
GHOST LANTERN! It glows green and hums.
Catfish in the fog. Was it always there?
A cart full of seaweed. Haunted groceries.
An eel slid up, cold as a ghost's handshake.

chompy_barks: Feed me junk, hon! I'm a growing wheel!
Googly eyes on the prize: more trash!
Om nom nom. Tires are my chewing gum.
Is that a cone? It's a party hat now.
Shopping cart! Free delivery to my belly.
Fish? Keep it. I want the gross stuff.
My wheel spins faster when I'm hungry.
Burp! Pardon me. That bucket was rich.
Harold, you're my favorite trash buddy.

crow_caught: A crow spotted you. Hide, Harold!
Lantern on you! Back to the stones!
The flock is shrieking. Time to go.
rose_picked: A rose for an old grave. Quiet now.
Petals down. The crows didn't blink.
One more rose laid. The wind sighs.
Thorns and all, a gift for the dead.
bottle: The unlabeled bottle, set down softly.
A toast to the poet. No one saw a thing.
Bottle placed. The grave seems to nod.
gate: The gate creaks. Slip out, slow and low.
Out the gate before the crows turn.
Latch clicks shut. The graveyard sleeps.
win: You got the Midnight Quill! The flock bows.
Clean sneak. The graveyard keeps your secret.
The Midnight Quill is yours. The crows yield.
lose: Spotted! The crows chase you to the street.
Too loud, Harold. The flock remembers.
Caught in the cone. Try the shadows.

phantoms_barks: Boo, hon. Did we scare your cane?
Fog's rolling in. That means us.
Cobblestones whisper our names.
We drift. You trip. Simple math.
Haunting the pier since forever, pal.
Who's got the ghost lantern? WE want it.
Chains rattle, rent's due, toad.
The water taxi won't stop for ghosts.
Shh. Footsteps on the old bricks.
Fells Point after dark is OUR block.
Little toad, big spooky mistake.
We float. Stairs are for the living.
I lost my head. Found it. Lost it again.
Mist on the masts. Perfect night.
Rattle the shutters, boys!
Tell your crab cakes we said boo.
Moon's up. Sheets on.
A grandpa with a cane? Fresh meat.
Haunt it slow, haunt it low.
Our tavern serves cold tea and colder stares.
Cross the square and you're cursed, hon.
Boo! Ha. He jumped. Write it down.
Ow! You can't hit a ghost! ...Ow again!
Fading out... back to the fog...
Okay, okay. Ghosts need naps too.

triples.intro: Welcome to my fog, little toad.
triples.taunt: Your cane passes right through me!
triples.defeat: Back to the deep... I drift...

triples.intro: The bells toll for you tonight.
triples.taunt: I've haunted tougher toads than you.

triples.intro: Bring me the lantern, or join my crew.
triples.taunt: Boo! Did that cane just shake?

triples.intro: Fells Point is mine after midnight.
triples.taunt: You're slow. Even for the living.

triples.intro: My crew walks the masts. You walk the plank.
triples.taunt: Mavis can't save you from a ghost, hon.
triples.defeat: I'll see you in the fog... someday...

triples.intro: Every pier creaks with my name.
